title: CARE-Drive: Coupled Alternating Refinement for Ego-trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2611.15360v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models bring multimodal understanding and world knowledge to end-to-end autonomous driving. To further improve the quality of predicted trajectories, existing studies introduce candidate refinement, residual denoising, and token correction. However, these methods typically focus on unified refinement of the entire trajectory, paying limited attention to the distinct physical quantities and their interactions. We further investigate physical specialization and coordination in trajectory refinement, centering on position and heading for simpler and more intuitive correction modeling. To this end, we propose CARE-Drive (Coupled Alternating Refinement for Ego-trajectories), which decomposes trajectory refinement into waypoint residual correction and position-conditioned heading generation. translated_title: CARE-Drive：面向自车轨迹的耦合交替精化方法
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为端到端自动驾驶带来了多模态理解能力和世界知识。为了进一步提升预测轨迹的质量，现有研究引入了候选轨迹精化、残差去噪和token修正等方法。然而，这些方法通常侧重于对整个轨迹进行统一精化，对不同物理量及其相互作用关注有限。我们进一步研究了轨迹精化中的物理量专门化与协调问题，聚焦于位置和航向角这两个量，以实现更简单、更直观的修正建模。为此，我们提出了CARE-Drive（面向自车轨迹的耦合交替精化），该方法将轨迹精化分解为路径点残差修正和以位置为条件的航向生成两个部分。通过模仿学习和未来token辅助任务，骨干网络提供预测表示和基础轨迹。
tldr: CARE-Drive将轨迹精化分解为路径点残差修正与以位置为条件的航向生成的耦合交替精化框架，实现了位置和航向的专门化建模，从而提升了端到端自动驾驶VLA模型的轨迹预测质量。
